name: neutral
source: the house template palette without the brand red, 2026-10-03
source_notes: accent1 is the template's navy 1E3C7D (10.51:1 on white), so every accent role reads navy.
accent2 is the deck blue 00A0E9 at 2.92:1 on white: fill only, never text.

accent3 to accent6 are the template's slates (dk2 4B5960, accent 6B7983) and two Office derivations of its bg1 (darker 35% A6A6A6, darker 15% D9D9D9), spread by lightness so no series pair falls under the colour-vision line.
1F36C7 is never used: it is a client's title blue in two references.

numerals.use: numerals and dates only; Montserrat Medium for the divider numeral

accent-ink.note: no lowering needed: 1E3C7D clears 10.51 on paper and 9.39 on card

fill_only.accent2: 00A0E9 is 2.92:1 on white, a fill or mark, never text
fill_only.accent5: A6A6A6 is 2.43:1 on white, a fill or mark, never text
fill_only.accent6: D9D9D9 is 1.41:1 on white, a fill or mark, never text
